mapper.select: SELECT SERVICECD AS serviceCd FROM UI_SERVICE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND IN_OUT = 'O' AND ( SUBSTR(SERVICECD, 1, 1) IN ('M', 'W') OR SUBSTR(SERVICECD, 1, 3) = 'EMM' )

SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, '' AS `inOut` FROM UI_SERVICE A WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND IN_OUT = 'O' AND ( SUBSTR(SERVICECD, 1, 1) IN ('M', 'W') OR SUBSTR(SERVICECD, 1, 3) = 'EMM' ) GROUP BY LEFT(SERVICECD, 1), SERVICENM_LV1, LEFT(SERVICECD, 3), SERVICENM_LV2 ORDER BY MAX(SORT)

SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm FROM UI_SERVICE
WHERE SERVICENM_LV1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
GROUP BY groupCd, groupNm ORDER BY MAX(SORT)

SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, '' AS `inOut` FROM UI_SERVICE A WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
AND LEFT(SERVICECD, 1) = #{groupCd}
AND ( LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR SERVICENM_LV2 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
GROUP BY LEFT(SERVICECD, 1), SERVICENM_LV1, LEFT(SERVICECD, 3), SERVICENM_LV2 ORDER BY MAX(SORT)

SELECT LEFT(SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, '' AS `inOut`, USE_YN AS useYn FROM UI_SERVICE A WHERE 1=1
AND USE_YN = #{searchUseYn}
AND ( LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR SERVICENM_LV2 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
GROUP BY LEFT(SERVICECD, 1), SERVICENM_LV1, LEFT(SERVICECD, 3), SERVICENM_LV2, USE_YN ORDER BY MAX(SORT)

SELECT SERVICECD AS serviceCd, SERVICENM_LV1 AS serviceLv1Nm, SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceLv2Nm, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2, CASE WHEN (LEFT(SERVICECD, 1) = 'E' OR SERVICECD IN ('SNVU','UWSH', 'UWSM', 'UWSL', 'WLVT', 'WLVS')OR LEFT(SERVICECD, 3) = 'CML') AND SERVICENM_LV3 != '' THEN CONCAT(' > ', SERVICENM_LV3) ELSE '' END) AS serviceNm, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2) AS groupNm, IN_OUT AS `inOut` FROM UI_SERVICE ORDER BY SORT

SELECT SERVICECD AS serviceCd, SERVICENM_LV1 AS serviceLv1Nm, SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceLv2Nm, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2, CASE WHEN SERVICENM_LV3 != '' THEN CONCAT(' > ', SERVICENM_LV3) ELSE '' END) AS serviceNm, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2) AS groupNm, IN_OUT AS `inOut` FROM UI_SERVICE ORDER BY SORT
SELECT DISTINCT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, A.SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm FROM UI_SERVICE A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 1) = 'I'
